title: Business Data Cloud with SAP AI Core: three AI-enhanced data product patterns
problem: Turn governed SAP business data into predictive and agentic AI outcomes.
depth: Primary SAP documentation; this session used search excerpts, full page body to be read before walkthrough
facts: Pattern 1: train in SAP Databricks on governed data products, register models, serve through AI Core.
Pattern 2: batch inference via AI Core workflow executions separated from low-latency serving.
Pattern 3: a BTP extension agent queries Datasphere, calls an AI Core endpoint and can use Generative AI Hub to explain results.
interpretations: Separating batch and real-time serving of one governed model is the architectural point to teach.
unknown: Full rationale and limits (page body not read this session)

decisions.selected: AI Core for governed serving of models trained in Databricks
decisions.reasoning: Source states AI Core provides enterprise governance, scaling and monitoring with SAP integration.

review_exercise: Pick batch or real-time for ticket categorisation, forecast refresh and fraud scoring, and justify.
lessons: Data products are the unit of reuse.
adaptation: Applies to service-ticket classification and sales forecasting in CX.
